doc.title: Tom Scott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: My face is hurting from smiling so much, Tom. That’s just marvelous. Well I want to thank you again for your time.
This has been like sort of a nice fantasy of mine and you made it come true.
Well glad to do it. Happy to do it. Your questions are great and I hope it serves the purpose.
Great. And welcome — I hope that you projects go well and that you keep doing what you’re doing, and I’m glad you didn’t fall back on the fall-back-on.
No. No I didn’t. I sure didn’t. All right. Thanks a lot.
I’ll just pause this, and, all right.
